windows: each patient's second coded seizure (a seizure record that is not a letter mention), 730 days; no window without one
p95_note: a p95 over n runs is the ceil(0.95 n)-th smallest: over the 12 runs of a request at one worker count (4 repeats of 3 runs) it is the maximum
order: ABBA: the reference first in even repeats, the candidate first in odd
limitations: one machine and one session; synthetic data replicated beyond 10,000 patients; four fixed requests with counts and two without, not a clinical mix; a pair's time is the median of a few runs in one process, so the pairing cancels slow drift, not noise inside a run
